name: Cross-site request forgery
signals: state-changing request lacks an unpredictable token
cookie-only auth with no SameSite protection
safe_tests: use only self-owned test accounts and reversible actions
capture the normal request and compare protection mechanisms
never target real users or irreversible actions
confirm: cross-site request changes state in the victim's test session
no user data or business data is harmed
false_positives: token required by a custom header
